title: One application-filing core behind the apply, quick, lead and CV doors
deviations_from_card: Scope shrunk to the CV door. application-filing.ts (fileApplication) owns tenant, sanitizeFreeText, identity-before-build, a build that always passes workspace+locale (injectable ProfileBuilder), the entry column, consent and the ack, with proof 'channel' | 'none'. cv-intake.ts is a thin wrapper (exported signature kept, plus an optional buildProfile). NOT migrated: app/api/apply/[id]/route.ts, lead-intake.ts, quick/route.ts. Their current layout is pinned literally by source-contract tests outside the write set (apply-ack-after-response, apply-intake-scope, apply-error-hygiene, quick-apply-status-link, gap-followup-candidate, and the LOCKED rate-limit-contract 'expensive: buildApplicantProfile(' marker). Card case 6 ('apply-intake-scope passes unchanged') also contradicts cases 4 and 7, which move the stage line those tests pin. Proof 'token' (the proven merge with profile rebuild) is not implemented, since only the conversational route would use it. Cases as landed: 1 tenant (CV door, W non-default, getProfileRecord in W, builder handed W and 'cs'); 2 identity-before-build, tightened per the critic: a same-named bystander with a different address gets no consent, events or merge, consent on the matched stub rises by exactly 1, the profile is not re-pointed, and the profile/entry counts are unchanged; 3 anonymous CVs twice give 2 entries; 4+5 in one test: Inbox axis plus exactly one consent event for the core ('none'), CV (degraded build) and lead doors; 6 proof 'none' at the core moves nothing (the existing reapply-capability-gate test passes unchanged); 7 source guard covering application-filing.ts and cv-intake.ts only. There is one commit (tests plus implementation) rather than test-then-feat, because a test-only commit cannot be green when the module does not exist yet. One test outside the write set was edited: in apply-intake-scope.test.ts, the non-vacuity loop now points at application-filing.ts instead of cv-intake.ts (a one-line change, because the idiom moved).
notes: Mutation-checked: removing workspaceId/locale from the core's build call turns case 1 red, and keying the dedupe on the label turns case 3 red. tsc exit 1 comes only from errors in the untracked kpi-sim/ run directory (foreign). On the first run, app/features/tools/devcases/DevTab.tsx was also red; that is a sibling's in-flight task-automation-engine work and had cleared by the re-run. Unit tests: 3287/3287 across app/_lib/*.test.ts and app/api/apply/**. Behaviour change for the integrator: an inbound or sim CV that repeats an existing applicant now records a re_applied event (coded repeatApplication/repeatApplicationContact) and backfills a missing contact, the same as the lead door. It returns the existing entry's candidateId, and no profile is built. Sim CV profiles now land in the caller's workspace instead of the default one. Card B's line numbers in route.ts are unaffected, because route.ts was not touched. Follow-up: migrate the conversational route and lead-intake.ts onto fileApplication (add proof 'token'), re-pointing the listed source-contract tests in the same change.
